html: New to GTA 6? There's no mission replay (guides report 15 manual save slots plus an autosave), and Rockstar has said cash you carry disappears if you die before depositing it. 6 beginner tips nobody tells you
Players found "Cool Dog": swim far from shore and a dog in a life vest rides up on a jet ski to rescue you, reportedly taking you to Dog Island in Grassrivers (Windows Central, TheGamer). More tips
GTA 6 has sold about 17 million digital copies, worth over $1.65 billion, according to Sensor Tower estimates (Reuters, Fox Business). About 3 in 4 were on PS5. Not official numbers yet. Our Short
GTA 6 runs at 30 FPS on every console, PS5 Pro included: Digital Foundry says the Pro is sharper and steadier, while the base PS5 can dip into the low 20s in heavy action. Launch day survival guide

Can't sign in? PSN had a big outage hours before launch; Sony's status page said it was resolved on the afternoon of Nov 18 (Axios). On PS5, install system update 14.23 for online features. What to do

GTA 6 cheats are real, but they only unlock after you finish the main story, many need their own challenge, and using one turns off saving and trophies for that session (Polygon, GamesRadar, PC Gamer). How cheats work · our Short

GTA 6 broke streaming launch records within minutes: over 7 million people watched at once across Twitch, Kick and YouTube, and Twitch alone peaked above 3 million (Streams Charts, Insider Gaming; preliminary).
GTA 6 scores 99 on Metacritic, tied with Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the highest score ever, with no mixed or negative reviews (Forbes, GameSpot, Kotaku). Review roundup.

Rockstar co-founder Sam Houser issued a rare launch statement: Rockstar tried to make GTA 6 "exceed your expectations" and show what games are capable of (GameSpot, GamesRadar). GameSpot also reports superb reviews and huge sales. Reviews.

GTA 6 is already playable in New Zealand (it unlocked at 6 AM ET), and some players are using the region trick to play early. A German streamer says Twitch warned him he could be suspended for streaming it early. The NZ trick explained.
Boxed copies of GTA 6 are a code in a box with no disc, according to Amazon's listings, so everyone downloads the full game. What that means.
Our Short on the fake GTA 6 cheat code lists is live, and the launch guides are now in Spanish too: guías en español.
Cheat codes: still none confirmed. Lists going around are recycled GTA 5 codes. Our cheats tracker.
The Game Awards 2026 nominations: GTA 6 gets 8, including Game of the Year. Lucia's actress, Manni L. Perez, is nominated for Best Performance. Details.
Reviews are reportedly due November 18, the day before launch (not confirmed by Rockstar). The score to beat.
Preload has been live since November 10: the install is up to 212 GB. Out of space?
